Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to recognize that the task was already resolved after Step 3. By Step 4, WebSurfer had already confirmed the release date (March 11, 2011) via multiple reliable sources (Wikipedia, Genius, Discogs). Instead of synthesizing this information to provide the final answer, the Planner issued identical instructions to WebSurfer to repeat the same searches ("Best Day Ever Mac Miller release date" and "Best Day Ever Discogs...") without any refinement or new objective. This created a redundant loop where the agent continued to gather the same verified data unnecessarily, delaying the completion of the task. This matches the pattern of "Redundant Instructions" and "Circular Workflow" seen in Example 2.
